flagged.title: Economy, society and the Nazi winners and losers
flagged.reason: F22 is mark-affecting because the video teaches that the Reich Mother's Cross was introduced in 1933 instead of December 1938, giving students the wrong date for a key examined Nazi social policy.

mark_affecting.quote: They took it so seriously, they even introduced the Reich Mother's Cross in 1933, literally handing out bronze, silver and gold medals to women
